pre_condition: work_dir is a Path object referring to an existing directory. prefix is a string.
post_condition: Returns a sorted list of string paths, sorted in ascending lexicographic order. When the directory work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/user_knowledge/ exists, each returned string equals prefix with any trailing "/" removed, followed by "/", followed by the POSIX-style relative path from work_dir to a file under work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/user_knowledge/ whose filename suffix (case-insensitive) is ".md" or ".markdown", excluding any file named exactly "manifest.json". When the user_knowledge directory does not exist or contains no qualifying files, the returned list is empty.
